versions.changelog: 补充中英文双语简介与财务、效率分类。Added a bilingual summary and finance and productivity categories.

Initial release of "take-back-my-latte-from-gemini":

- Analyzes Gemini Cloud Billing and usage JSON to calculate actual Google AI spend, expressed in lattes.
- Estimates how many lattes the user could potentially recover next month, with a concise, actionable report.
- Supports Gemini API and Gemini on Vertex AI billing data only—excludes other cloud services.
- Ensures privacy: analyzes billing files locally, does not request API keys or upload data.
- Presents clear recoverable cost analysis and actionable suggestions, always ending with a website action link.
